selected_inputs: the intended record section 1 (registers, gating fields, checks)
the D27 runbook and issue inventory

args: node --check tests/closure/structural-check.mjs && for j in tests/closure/registers/*.json tests/envmap/facts/D28.json tests/reprove/runbook.json tests/manifest/issues.json; do node -e 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1]))' $j || exit 1; done && ! grep -nE "'(FACT|EV|ENV|IMPL|PROBE)-[A-Z0-9]" tests/closure/*.mjs && node -e 'const J=p=>JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(p));const D=J("tests/closure/registers/decisions.json");const K=J("tests/closure/registers/constraints.json");const S=J("tests/closure/registers/sequence.json");const A=J("tests/closure/registers/acceptance-test.json");if(D.rows.length!==14||K.rows.length!==11||!S.steps.every(s=>Array.isArray(s.decisions)&&Array.isArray(s.constraints)&&s.assumption)||!A.steps.every(s=>Array.isArray(s.external_constraints)))process.exit(1);const I=J("tests/manifest/issues.json").issues;const by=Object.fromEntries(I.map(i=>[i.id,i]));if(I.length!==41||by["I-38"].covers.length!==0)process.exit(1);const Rb=J("tests/reprove/runbook.json");if(Object.keys(Rb.facts).length!==129)process.exit(1);const F=J("tests/envmap/facts/D28.json");if(F.facts.length!==3)process.exit(1);console.log("decisions",D.rows.length,"constraints",K.rows.length,"runbook facts",Object.keys(Rb.facts).length,"facts",F.facts.length)' && echo 'syntax, JSON, no fact/evidence/node name in the tools; registers as intended'

T=$(mktemp -d) && node tests/closure/structural-check.mjs --registers tests/closure/registers --components tests/manifest/components.json --graph design/environment-map/graph.json --facts-spec tests/envmap/facts/D28.json --root . --render $T/registers.md --out $T/structural-check.json && node -e 'const s=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1]));console.log(JSON.stringify(s.counts));if(s.status!=="PASS"||s.counts.decisions!==14||s.counts.constraints!==11||s.checks.length!==11)process.exit(1)' $T/structural-check.json
